tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// sgrol ma'i zhal phyag la spel ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las kun// gcig tu bsdus pa lha mo'i skur// ston mdzad rje btsun sgrol ma yis// rtag tu khyod ni skyong gyur cig /de yi phyag g.yas brkyang pa ni// khyed kyi spyi bor gzhol zhing bab// mchog sbyin dam pa'i phyag rgya yis// khyed la 'bras mchog stsol gyur cig /phyag g.yon utpal 'dzin pa yis// khyed kyang bzung nas nyer drangs te// nyid kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// nye bar bcug nas skyong gyur cig /dpon mo chen mo la'o// //ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga twa hya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
